arguments.code:
from mpi4py import MPI
import numpy as np

comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank = comm.Get_rank()
size = comm.Get_size()

local = np.random.rand(1000)
total = np.zeros(1) if rank == 0 else None
comm.Reduce(np.sum(local), total, op=MPI.SUM, root=0)

if rank == 0:
    print(f'Sum across {size} ranks: {total[0]}')
